body_markdown:
October is Energy Awareness Month, making it the perfect time to tackle vampire power and other forms of energy waste in your home. Saving energy and money is a treat you can enjoy all year long. Here are some easy steps to get started:


- **Embrace Power-Saving Strips** : Protect your home from vampire power and phantom loads by using advanced power strips. These strips detect when electronics are inactive and automatically cut off their power supply, resulting in significant energy savings. Qualifying Entergy Mississippi customers can save up to $25 with power strip incentives.
- **Upgrade to Energy-Efficient Appliances** : Switch to high-efficiency appliances like heat pump water heaters and refrigerators, designed to reduce energy consumption and lower your energy costs. Enjoy online or in-store incentives on a wide variety of select ENERGY STAR® certified products, ensuring immediate and ongoing energy savings.
- **Put Smart Thermostats to Work for You** : Upgrade to Wi-Fi enabled thermostats that intelligently adjust your home’s temperature settings for optimal performance and energy efficiency. Save even more with a $100 instant incentive when you purchase an eligible smart thermostat.
- **Seal and Insulate** : Our Residential Energy Audit and Direct Install Program offers incentives on duct sealing, air sealing, and ceiling insulation. These upgrades are crucial for keeping your home comfortable year-round while minimizing energy waste.


Scare away energy waste with the enticing incentives provided by Entergy Solutions. From energy-efficient appliances to air and duct sealing, you can save both energy and money. For more information, visit **entergysolutionsms.com** and take a step towards eliminating vampire power from your home.
